# dsh-miliastra v0.7.1

**安装**：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-miliastra@0.7.1` → **重启 `dsh web`**
**Install**: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-miliastra@0.7.1`, then **restart `dsh web`**.

[中文](#cn-v0.7.1) | [English](#en-v0.7.1)

---

<h3 id="cn-v0.7.1">🚀 新增功能</h3>

本版是**按 AI 实际调用体验**（作者 2026-10-04 交办：「按 ai 使用来判断是否优化」）逐条落地的一版 ——
把一整天 30+ 轮「构建 → 门禁 → 部署 → 日志 → 截图」里真正疼的地方固化成工具。

- **部署前自动门禁 + 下一步固化**：`miliastra_code op=deploy withGates:true` ⇒ 写盘前先跑内置 preflight
  （语法 / 作用域 / 全局写审计），**没过就不写盘**并回放失败门（`code:"PRECHECK_FAILED"`）；
  回执的 `nextStep` 固化「**存盘 → 试玩 → 对账**」三步（`match:false` = 他试的是旧代码，别急着查脚本）。
- **`prodUnchanged`**：这次投进去的内容与上次**逐字节相同** ⇒ 直接点破「改了源没 build / 改的是构建产物」。
- **模板审计 `miliastra_map op=audit-template`**：子树（递归）/ **同父重名**（`GetChild` 歧义）/
  **同名多条独立控件**（"另存为/复制一份"留下的 A/B 形态）/ `idExists` / 可选名字清单与代码引用对账。
- ★ **图源号逆出来了**：控件记录子树里落在**平台图片号段 100001~112042** 的 varint = 该控件的图源号。
  对照证据：日志报 `图片图源=106045`，而 `.gil` 里 `106045` **恰好出现 29 次**且落在 29 条控件里。
  ⇒ 名字含「图片」却**一个号都没有**的节点会被点名（**会渲染成 `?`**）；实测那张图 923 个「图片」里 **69 个缺号**。
- **`miliastra_log op=run-analysis`**：命令应答 ↔ 画面变化配对，**点名「有命令应答、其后没有画面记录」**。
  实测本机一局：命令 88 / 画面记录 92 / **有命令无画面 19**。
- **两条按形状自动挂的已知坑**：`applyVars(` ⇒ 「变量回写即时字段**慢一拍**，显示源改走**直推**（Invoke）」；
  `SetAsLastSibling(` ⇒ 「返回值**可能恒 false**，别拿它当判据，层级用创建顺序兜底」。

<h3 id="cn-v0.7.1-fix">🐛 问题修复</h3>

- **`op=restore` 写错活文件**（P0 数据损坏）：备份名能推断目标就**以它为准**；与显式 `file` 不符 ⇒
  **拒绝写盘**（`code:"RESTORE_TARGET_MISMATCH"` + 两条改法）。
- **存盘状态比较必须去 UTF-8 BOM**：实测 11 条活文件全带 BOM、`.gil` 嵌的是去 BOM 那份（每条少 3 字节）
  ⇒ 直接比 sha 会把**刚存过盘的图判成"该存盘了"**。现在 `liveSha` 用去 BOM 后的哈希（另留 `liveShaRaw`/`bomStripped`）；
  **去 BOM 后仍不等照旧判 `dirty`**；「只有 BOM、没有内容」的空文件点名说清（不再含糊成"sha 没读到"）。
- **`op=errors` 的 `fileLine` 真因**：兜底正则原来**锚在行首**，而真机报错行**行首还挂着别的内容**
  （`…CursorEnter): 表现 view:580: attempt to call a nil value`）⇒ 加**不锚行首**的第 ④ 条形态；
  实测那份日志 **48/48** 拿到位置（原来 48/48 全 `null`）。
- **`.gia` 半截快照可验证判据**：`emptyButHasBytes` / `complete`（含解析失败那条早退路径）+ 回执 `partialSnapshot`
  ⇒ 明说「**这里没有报错不能当结论**」（`.gia` 一局结束才落盘，局中读到的是半截）。
- **时序硬依据**：`op=tail/grep` 每行带 `seq` + `i`；**实测 `seq` 在一局里恒为同一个值**（本机 428 条全是 `seq=700`）
  ⇒ 回执明写「**同秒内以 `i` 为准**，别假设 `seq` 单调」（作者曾因此把"渲染慢一拍"误判成时序问题）。

<h3 id="cn-v0.7.1-chores">⚠️ 其他变更</h3>

- 删掉 3 条**读活数据**的测试套件（`gilreport-test` / `nodegraph-test` / `uilint-test`），
  其中 **`uilint-test` 用纯夹具恢复** —— 它守的是「文本框高 < 字号×1.4 ⇒ 真机一个像素都不画」这条**离线唯一能拦**的坑。
- `fx-hardening-test` ②g 改为**钉死同一个 `.gia`** 再比 `summaryOnly`（原写法两次调用各自解析"最新日志"，作者在试玩时必然假红）。
- 工具 schema 仍在 **34 KB 棘轮**内。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1

<h3 id="en-v0.7.1">🚀 New Features</h3>

This release was driven by **how the agent actually uses the tools** (a day of 30+ round-trips through
build → gates → deploy → logs → screenshots), turning each real friction point into a first-class capability.

- **Pre-deploy gates + a fixed next step**: `miliastra_code op=deploy withGates:true` runs the built-in preflight
  (syntax / scope / global-write audit) **before writing**; if it fails, **nothing is written** and the failing gates are
  replayed (`code:"PRECHECK_FAILED"`). `nextStep` now fixes the chain **save → playtest → reconcile**
  (`match:false` means the human played the old code — don't start debugging the script).
- **`prodUnchanged`**: the deployed bytes are identical to the previous deploy ⇒ says out loud "you edited a source but never
  built, or you edited a build artifact".
- **Template audit `miliastra_map op=audit-template`**: recursive subtree, **duplicate names under the same parent**
  (`GetChild` ambiguity), **duplicate standalone controls** (the save-as copy A/B shape), `idExists`, and an optional
  name list reconciled against your code references.
- ★ **Image source id, decoded**: a varint inside a control record's subtree that falls in the platform image catalog range
  **100001–112042** is that control's image source. Cross-checked against runtime logs: the log reported `图片图源=106045`
  and `.gil` contains `106045` **exactly 29 times**, all inside 29 control records. Image-named controls with **no** source id
  are flagged (**they will render as `?`**) — on one real map, 69 of 923 image controls.
- **`miliastra_log op=run-analysis`**: pairs command acknowledgements with subsequent UI/render records and names the ones
  with **no UI record afterwards** (one real run: 88 commands / 92 UI records / **19 with no UI record**).
- **Two shape-triggered known pitfalls**: `applyVars(` ⇒ "variable round-trips lag one frame for immediate UI; use direct
  `Invoke` instead"; `SetAsLastSibling(` ⇒ "its return value may be constantly `false`; don't use it as a criterion".

<h3 id="en-v0.7.1-fix">🐛 Bug Fixes</h3>

- **`op=restore` wrote the wrong live file** (P0, data loss): the backup file name now decides the target when it can, and a
  conflict with an explicit `file` is **refused** (`code:"RESTORE_TARGET_MISMATCH"`).
- **Save-state comparison must strip the UTF-8 BOM**: all 11 live files carried a BOM while `.gil` embeds the BOM-less copy
  (3 bytes shorter each), so a raw hash comparison called a freshly saved map "needs saving". `liveSha` is now the
  BOM-stripped hash (`liveShaRaw`/`bomStripped` kept); a difference that survives stripping still counts as one.
- **`op=errors` `fileLine` root cause**: the fallback pattern was **anchored at line start**, while real error lines carry a
  prefix (`…CursorEnter): 表现 view:580: attempt to call a nil value`) ⇒ added a non-anchored pattern;
  on one real log **48/48** now resolve (previously 48/48 were `null`).
- **`.gia` partial-snapshot detection**: `emptyButHasBytes` / `complete` (including the early-return parse-failure path) plus a
  `partialSnapshot` warning, so "no errors here" is never silently concluded from a half-written log.
- **Ordering evidence**: `op=tail/grep` rows carry `seq` and `i`; **measured**: `seq` can be a constant within a run
  (all 428 records had `seq=700`) ⇒ the receipt states "**use `i` within the same second**; do not assume `seq` is monotonic".

<h3 id="en-v0.7.1-chores">⚠️ Chores</h3>

- Removed three suites that asserted on live data; **`uilint-test` was restored with pure fixtures** — it guards the rule that
  a text box shorter than fontSize×1.4 renders **nothing at all** on device (the only offline guard for that pit).
- `fx-hardening-test` ②g now pins one `.gia` before comparing `summaryOnly` sizes.
- Tool schema stays inside the 34 KB ratchet.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1
